title: 2.Bộ 10 đề thi cuối kì 2 Tiếng Anh 11 Global Success có đáp án

questions.content: Câu 1: What are Matt and Ava doing?
options: A. They’re planning their summer holiday.
B. They’re talking about the impacts of tourism.
C. They’re discussing which heritage preservation project to volunteer for.

questions.content: Câu 2: Why doesn’t Ava think Matt should visit Hawaii?
options: A. Because it’s tourist season.
B. Because Hawaiians don’t want more tourists.
C. Because it’s inconvenient to travel there.

questions.content: Câu 3: What does Matt usually do when he travels?
options: A. He buys some stuff from local people.
B. He fulfils his responsibility before departing.
C. He books the cheapest tour.

questions.content: Câu 4: What does Ava think about tourists?
options: A. They have a sense of responsibility.
B. They don’t know much about other countries' cultural heritage.
C. They can destroy the place they visit.

questions.content: Câu 5: According to Matt, what is the benefit of tourism?
options: A. Discouraging tourists from bad behaviour
B. Helping many heritage preservation and protection projects
C. Making local people famous
questions.note: B là đáp án đúng Script: Ava: What are you doing, Matt? Matt: Hi, Ava. Having planned a summer holiday in Hawaii, I’m learning a few basic Hawaiian phrases. Ava: I don't think this is the ideal time to visit Hawaii. Matt: Why not? Ava: Having suffered from over-tourism, the locals are asking tourists to stop visiting the island. Thousands of new arrivals every day are creating traffic jams, overcrowding and resource depletion; and the local people have to cope with their consequences every day. Matt: Actually, I have heard of the problem but I try to be responsible whenever I travel. I'm aware of the impact on the environment and the local community. Therefore, I usually shop locally to help the community's economy. When possible, I always book eco-tours. Ava: Not every tourist shares your sense of responsibility. Some use natural heritage sites as a backdrop for their pictures and display disrespectful behaviour towards other countries' cultural heritage. In some cases, tourists even destroyed natural and cultural landmarks. Matt: Some tourists can misbehave; however, I think tourism, in general, can be beneficial. It was the financial gain from tourism that contributed to many projects that preserved and protected heritage values. Having received more job opportunities, local people also benefit from the popularity of tourism.

questions.content: Câu 6: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A. How to face loneliness and helplessness at home
B. Ways to gain independence while studying abroad
C. Overseas students and problems with additional expenses
D. Young students’ adjustment to sharing an apartment

questions.content: Câu 7: What does the word those in line 14 mean?
options: A. flatmates
B. acquaintances
C. housekeepers
D. instructors

questions.content: Câu 8: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT given in the list of advice to live independently?
options: A. Cooking skills
B. Clean-up skills
C. Communication skills
D. Budget management skills
